import_dir.ask: Folder watched for worklist files (on the SpectroFlo PC, or a share of it)
import_dir.help: The package writes one mhp_<job>.csv per acquisition here. A helper script, or the person at the SpectroFlo PC, acquires the sample as the row says and exports the FCS file named by the token.

results_dir.ask: Folder where SpectroFlo's FCS exports (and statistics CSV) land
results_dir.help: SpectroFlo stores FCS files in its Export folder (C:\CytekbioExport by default; Storage Preferences). Point this at that folder or a subfolder the helper exports into; the FCS file name must contain the mhp_<job> token.

software.ask: SpectroFlo version on the acquisition PC (for the record)

allowed_templates.ask: Experiment template names an agent may queue (JSON list; empty allows any)

result_wait_s.ask: Seconds to wait for the FCS file before the job fails

poll_s.ask: Seconds between looks at the export folder
